capabilities: create notes with pinball machine details
link to machines on popular pinball websites
organize machines as a database in the vault
extras: The README contains no usage instructions beyond the feature description; most of it is developer release instructions (version bumping, building, and attaching files to GitHub releases).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to catalog pinball machines and track per-machine scores in a structured vault database.
summary: Pinball machine database plugin that creates notes with machine details, website deep links, and score records.
